source.name: Ghana - Subnational Administrative Boundaries (COD-AB)
source.publisher: OCHA (HDX), contributed by OCHA ROWCA; underlying source: Ghana Statistical Service
source.coverage: 16 regions and 260 districts (P-codes, district-to-region membership, centroids). Guan District (Oti, L.I. 2416) is absent.
source.notes: Common Operational Dataset compiled from Ghana Statistical Service boundaries. Not checked against a current MLGDRA gazette list (unavailable at retrieval). Region 'Northern East' is recorded as 'North East' with the source spelling as an alias. Centroids are polygon centres, not locations.
